section_title: Case example: Using typology reports to enhance AML controls

propositions.proposition: Isabella审查客户群体并确认存在大量学生账户。
source_quotes: Isabella reviews her organization's client population and confirms a large number of student accounts.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 审查客户群体并确认存在大量学生账户
outcomes_or_paths: 确认存在大量学生账户

evidence_spans.quote: Isabella reviews her organization's client population and confirms a large number of student accounts.

propositions.proposition: 由于账户数量过多无法手动审查，Isabella与数据团队合作进一步细分客户群体。
source_quotes: There are more accounts than she can review manually, so she works with the internal data team to identify ways to segment this population further.

trigger_or_context: 账户数量过多无法手动审查
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 与数据团队合作进一步细分客户群体

evidence_spans.quote: There are more accounts than she can review manually, so she works with the internal data team to identify ways to segment this population further.

propositions.proposition: Isabella通过细分策略识别异常行为账户，以及支付备注或客户沟通中提及VASP或加密资产的账户。
source_quotes: She is able to identify accounts that are behaving unusually using this strategy.
She also identifies accounts that mention the name of a VASP or a particular cryptoasset in payment references or via customer communication.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 识别异常行为账户和提及VASP/加密资产的账户
outcomes_or_paths: 发现异常行为账户和提及VASP/加密资产的账户

evidence_spans.quote: She is able to identify accounts that are behaving unusually using this strategy.
She also identifies accounts that mention the name of a VASP or a particular cryptoasset in payment references or via customer communication.

propositions.proposition: Isabella向高级管理层报告趋势，准备并提交可疑活动报告，确保FIU知晓，并向工作组反馈。
source_quotes: Isabella reports this trend to senior management, then prepares and files SARs, ensuring that the FIU knows these reports are being submitted because of the public-private partnership. She also reports her findings to the working group and confirms that their typology appears to be sound.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 报告趋势、提交SARs、向工作组反馈
outcomes_or_paths: 工作组确认类型学有效

evidence_spans.quote: Isabella reports this trend to senior management, then prepares and files SARs, ensuring that the FIU knows these reports are being submitted because of the public-private partnership. She also reports her findings to the working group and confirms that their typology appears to be sound.

propositions.proposition: Isabella向高级内部委员会提交发现和建议，包括调整KYC和客户风险参数以及交易监控流程。
source_quotes: Isabella also presents the findings to a senior internal committee along with recommendations for better protecting the organization from this activity in the future. Her recommendations include changes to the KYC and client risk profile parameters as well as adjustments to transaction monitoring processes.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 向高级内部委员会提交发现和建议
outcomes_or_paths: 提交KYC和风险参数调整等建议

evidence_spans.quote: Isabella also presents the findings to a senior internal committee along with recommendations for better protecting the organization from this activity in the future. Her recommendations include changes to the KYC and client risk profile parameters as well as adjustments to transaction monitoring processes.

propositions.proposition: 执法机构为应对洗钱趋势成立工作组，旨在产生更好的情报以检测参与者并改进私营部门控制。
source_quotes: Law enforcement sets up a working group to address this trend. The group includes the FIU, regulator, and representatives of the bank and virtual assets sectors. The group's aim is to produce better intelligence to detect those involved in this activity and improve controls in the private sector.

outcomes_or_paths: 工作组包括FIU、监管机构及银行和虚拟资产行业代表，旨在产生情报并改进控制

evidence_spans.quote: Law enforcement sets up a working group to address this trend. The group includes the FIU, regulator, and representatives of the bank and virtual assets sectors. The group's aim is to produce better intelligence to detect those involved in this activity and improve controls in the private sector.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: S1.1候选仅涵盖Isabella的客户审查，未涉及执法机构成立工作组这一应对流程。

propositions.proposition: Isabella在组织受邀加入工作组后，获得高级管理层的同意。
source_quotes: Isabella's organization is invited to join the group. She obtains agreement from senior management.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 获得高级管理层同意加入

evidence_spans.quote: Isabella's organization is invited to join the group. She obtains agreement from senior management.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: S1.1候选遗漏了受邀后获取高层同意的内部批准步骤，该步骤是Isabella参与行动的前置程序。

propositions.proposition: 执法机构通过工作组发布类型学报告，解释学生利用VASP和银行账户转移犯罪收益的洗钱方式。
source_quotes: Law enforcement issues a typology report via the group, explaining how the suspected money laundering happens. The report indicates that students open accounts with VASPs and move the proceeds of crime to and from these accounts via their local bank accounts.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 执法机构发布类型学报告
outcomes_or_paths: 报告揭示学生利用VASP和银行账户洗钱的模式

evidence_spans.quote: Law enforcement issues a typology report via the group, explaining how the suspected money laundering happens. The report indicates that students open accounts with VASPs and move the proceeds of crime to and from these accounts via their local bank accounts.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: S1.1候选覆盖了基于细分策略识别异常账户，但遗漏了执法机构发布类型学报告这一关键信息输入环节。

propositions.proposition: 工作组要求参与组织考虑类型学信息、审查数据以确认类型学并识别匹配的客户活动。
source_quotes: The group requests that participant organizations consider this information, review their data to confirm the typology, and identify customer activity that aligns.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 向参与组织发出审查要求
outcomes_or_paths: 要求参与组织审查数据并识别匹配活动

evidence_spans.quote: The group requests that participant organizations consider this information, review their data to confirm the typology, and identify customer activity that aligns.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: S1.1候选覆盖了Isabella的审查行动，但未包含工作组发出的审查要求这一前置指令。
